lens: Boutique recruiter operational fit: affected-finding follow-up on immutable GET-5-product-v2, baseline d363ac04 plus manifest-frozen implementation. Synthetic independent recruiter continuing a mobile note through contact review, deliberate saving, restart and one fork. This packet reassesses its own v1 findings and adjacent proof; field usefulness and deployment are outside the directly observed evidence.

findings.criterion: Write safety: the pending-save footer still describes an unsubmitted proposal
findings.observation: Supported code risk, residual of v1 finding 1: the main unknown-save error is now truthful, but the card footer still chooses “Proposed only · nothing changes until you confirm” whenever saveMessage is nil. A current pending write after a lost response has exactly that state. The footer does not branch on hasPendingWrite, although the title, banner and retry button do. This remains misleading after the recruiter already confirmed and the server may have committed. The new screenshots stop above the footer, so this is not claimed as a directly observed screenshot defect.
findings.evidence: /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:5049-5055 selects the corrected unknown result without setting saveMessage; :5733-5749 selects the first-save footer solely from isCurrent/saveMessage; :6447-6451 uses hasPendingWrite for the retry title. /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:5035-5041 only asserts contact-save-error, not contact-proposal-boundary. The observed main-message correction is visible in /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshots/24-authenticated-unknown-save-v2.png; its recovery case passes at /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:561.
findings.user_impact: Supported operational inference: the recruiter can encounter a second, incompatible description of the operation while scrolling to the save/retry area. The prominent corrected message substantially reduces the v1 problem, but the footer can still suggest that the first confirmation has not occurred.
findings.recommendation: For a current card with hasPendingWrite and no receipt, choose a submitted/unknown-result footer before the proposal-only branch, for example “Submitted · check the original save for its result”. Keep the original operation locked. This is a copy-state correction; no new capability is needed.
findings.verification: Extend the existing authenticated after-commit response-loss/relaunch test to reveal contact-proposal-boundary before and after relaunch. Assert that its text describes an uncertain submitted operation and contains neither “Proposed only” nor a new-confirmation assurance. Keep the original receipt, same-operation retry and People-readback checks. Capture the full recovery card including its footer.

strengths: Frozen provenance: independently recomputed SHA-256 for all 107 v2 manifest entries; every hash matched. The final backend proof source hashes match all 12 corresponding frozen sources, and every screenshot-provider source hash that is represented in the manifest matches. Compiled dist files referenced by that proof are not in this snapshot. No other reviewer packet or score was read; no implementation, Simulator or service mutation was performed.

Resolved v1 finding 2 / interruption recovery = 3/4: the fork is visibly labeled “Fork”, and its accessibility label says “Forked Session”, while the original retains its original title and history. Direct proof: /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshots/16-fork-label-v2.png; /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveView.swift:3554-3574 and :3672-3682; /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/UITests/Get5SessionUITests.swift:67-91; /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-panel2-r1.log:1504. The persistent field is originSessionID, not a transient toast. The exact two-branch next-day field task remains unobserved.

Write safety = 2/4 because one footer branch remains inconsistent. The high-severity v1 main error is corrected: the screen now says “The save outcome needs checking” and offers “Retry same operation”. Authenticated response-loss/relaunch/retry/receipt/People-readback passes in /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:561-575; exact checks are in /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:5035-5092. /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshots/24-authenticated-unknown-save-v2.png directly shows the corrected main error. No duplicate-write failure was observed.

State integrity = 3/4. The authenticated canonical app case deliberately creates Noor Vega, restarts, retains one Session with the exact original source and a receipt, previews shared deletion scope, cancels deletion, and reopens the same receipt. /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/UITests/Get5CanonicalSessionUITests.swift:14-91; /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-canonical-panel2-r5.log:426; /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshots/22-authenticated-delete-scope-v2.png and screenshots/23-authenticated-session-source-receipt-v2.png. This proves authenticated single-Simulator task completion and deletion cancellation; it does not prove deletion propagation on a second phone.

Capture burden = 3/4, retained from the unchanged bounded capture review. Natural name/email input stages a draft, and deterministic voice remains editable without sending; text/hold/tap controls have recorded native passes. /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/conversation-provider-proof.json:153-246; /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r6.log:1012, :1060 and :1330; /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshots/02-voice-draft.png. Total user effort versus manual entry and actual transcription accuracy remain unmeasured.

Evidence review = 3/4. The draft retains an inspectable source and field excerpts; incomplete relationship context disables saving and can be declined while the message survives. /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:5552-5567 and :5762-5778; /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r6.log:1287. The previously incomplete native screenshot source/detail/follow-up test now has a passing individual result at /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r8.log:372. This is a deterministic screenshot fixture, separately supported by the actual-provider tests below.

Action usefulness = 3/4 for the bounded contact job. Saving yields a receipt and a working People destination in the authenticated recovery trace (/tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:540-561). In two final configured GLM trials, “What does Friday mean?” uses existing canonical screenshot context, keeps date/timezone uncertainty, and suggests checking existing capture or asking for the missing timing; it does not demand a duplicate screenshot upload. /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshot-provider-proof.v3.json:46-179 and :182-355. These are two observed answers, not a reliability or candidate-momentum outcome estimate.

Wedge discipline = 3/4. The affected corrections improve ordinary retrieval and review without adding unrelated features. The screenshot follow-up is explicitly proposed/unconfirmed and carries no formal write in both final trials (/tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshot-provider-proof.v3.json:162-179 and :338-355). The shared deletion preview states the scope and says saved contacts and other Sessions stay unchanged (/tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshots/22-authenticated-delete-scope-v2.png). No person scoring is visible in the affected surfaces.

Additional bounded dependency proof: /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/backend-clock-after.log:92-95 records 87/87 final affected tests. /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/backend-proof.v2.json:6-12 identifies 42 PostgreSQL Session cases and 34 provider cases. This closes the v1 absence of an inspectable final backend log; it does not convert a provider response or database test into field usefulness.
missing_evidence: Trigger relevance remains 2/4. The v2 brief retains a plausible recent-conversation task but no concrete active-search count, decision deadline or competing task. The same unconfirmed Friday scenario is useful for continuity but is not a realistic urgency/attention study. Add one interrupted recruiter search task with an explicit commitment before claiming complete operational fit. This is a research/test gap, not a demonstrated product failure.

Field-value hypothesis remains open: no recruiter observation establishes lower effort than copying a note/manual contact entry, reliable detection of seeded identity/purpose errors, fewer missed commitments, or improved outcomes. A moderated comparison should measure source checking, correction burden, total task time and return-to-task accuracy. No score of 4 or field-usefulness claim is awarded.

The authenticated native proof uses one Simulator and a loopback simulated-login/keychain bridge. It does not exercise two actual phones, next-day return, changed external contact state, or physical-device VoiceOver. The deletion test previews and cancels; it does not itself demonstrate actual multi-device deletion. These are scope limits, not evidence that sync/deletion fails.

The fork label is directly visible and accessible after the native edge-back journey, but the exact v1 proposed verification with different subsequent messages in both branches and a later restart was not performed in that UI test. Existing persisted origin identity supports the correction; cross-day retrieval effectiveness is still inferred.

The unreattachable-original-images case from v1 remains untested. The existing recovery gate preserves the original task and avoids text replay; this packet does not infer that removing the gate is safe.

Native proof is cumulative: the canonical case passes at /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-canonical-panel2-r5.log:426, but that file also contains a failed recovery case and ends TEST FAILED. The recovery is separately green at /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:561-575. Likewise only the screenshot case is credited in final-r8, and only the specified fork/AX5 cases in panel2-r1. No single all-green native suite is claimed.

The old general conversation provider trial remains a bounded continuity example that writes from applicant to recruiter after an ambiguous prompt. The new screenshot trials demonstrate a narrower useful clarification, not an explicit recruiter-to-candidate outreach task. Production parity, deployment, TestFlight distribution and physical-device proof remain with root and are not asserted here.
